name: 24562-batchdecode-minimaxm2-tp4
model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2. ~213 GiB of safetensors, ungated, not in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=4, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier. FOUR IS NOT A FREE PARAMETER: at eight-way this checkpoint's MoE weight creation rejects the shard and the server does not start, two-way does not hold ~213 GiB, and --ep-size moves the item off the shape it is declared over.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- roughly five to six minutes of steady state.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets. Prompts uniform in [1004, 1044] tokens and outputs pinned at exactly 1024, with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` in `extras.body`.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on four GPUs, serving 16 concurrent users thousand-token prompts and thousand-token replies.
launch:
model-path: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2

# tp-size is load-bearing, not a fitting choice: at eight this checkpoint's MoE weight creation
# rejects the shard and the server never starts, and at two the weights do not fit.
tp-size: 4

# The checkpoint ships an auto_map and its own tokenizer files.
trust-remote-code: true

moe-runner-backend: triton

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
